Implemented `fit_prony_and_predict_stress` in `/holdout_task/prony_rheology.py`. It fits nonnegative Prony moduli while accounting for affine drift and spike outliers, then predicts stress without drift.

On the public experiment, relative stress RMSE was 0.287% and relative equilibrium-modulus error was 4.84%. Both met the requested thresholds. Holdout performance was not measured.
